name: zonterone-cc-batteries
description: A collection of Claude Code skills: coding guidelines, deep code review, code style and library conventions.

plugins.name: karpathy-guidelines
plugins.description: Behavioral guidelines that reduce common LLM coding mistakes: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution.

plugins.name: deep-code-review
plugins.description: Deep code review by three parallel reviewer subagents (quality, implementation, simplification), every finding verified against the code.

plugins.name: code-comments
plugins.description: Keeps code comments to a minimum: classifies each one and keeps only decision records.

plugins.name: react-code-style
plugins.description: Recommendations for writing React code: derived state, Effects, re-renders and memoization.

plugins.name: neverthrow
plugins.description: Opinionated project convention for error handling with the neverthrow library. Enable it per project.

plugins.name: ts-pattern
plugins.description: Opinionated project convention for pattern matching with the ts-pattern library. Enable it per project.
